# Feature: Chaser — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #32 (Chaser) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: copies your moves to hunt you. Unique: the only enemy that reacts to your inputs. Useful: you lead it into walls and traps with your own path. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** copies your moves to hunt you.

**So that** you lead it into walls and traps with your own path.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Chaser for the first time in its teaching room (mech-32-chaser-room). Teaching moment: First room: a chaser in an open room with one dead end. A player who runs straight for the orb leads the chaser's copied steps into the dead end behind them and is caught, so the retry teaches that your own path is the control you have over it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: After each of your moves it takes one step in the same direction you just moved, if that tile is free
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Otherwise it stays
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It is lethal on touch, so your own path steers it into walls

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Otherwise it stays
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Chaser's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-32-chaser-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #32.
